verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents a Raw Event Export API that returns all event data with every property as JSONL. It also offers an Engage API for user profiles, UI CSV exports and GDPR retrieval/deletion APIs, and a community user calls its export policy "great". That covers the core of exporting raw data in open formats and leaving. Missing for 10: evidence that session replays, dashboards/report definitions and cohorts can be exported in bulk; a documented account offboarding or closure process; independent hands-on corroboration of a complete exit.
